name: Conrad
source:
An old acquaintance of Sam's, Conrad is an older gentleman still learning the ins and outs of Love Shore's underworld. He might be a little cold at first.

Can you get him to warm up?

Likes:

- Coffee
- Being good at his job
- Neutral colors

Dislikes:

- Sam pointing out his age

Sign: Pisces

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/loveshore/love-shore-game-a-queer-sci-fi-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]

Romance option for Sam.
